## Measuring Human Intelligence Debt

Etiquetas: Aprendizaje y transmisión de capacidades 8.00%; Capacidad humana y deuda de inteligencia 28.00%; Decisiones y responsabilidad 8.00%; Economía, costes y liquidez 12.00%; Empresa y gestión 8.00%; Evidencia, procedencia y atribución 16.00%; Experimentación, falsación y contraejemplos 8.00%; Memoria, comunidad y territorio 12.00%

relations.title: HR & Processess Rationalization
relations.reading: Capacity estimates can be strengthened by grading the evidence behind each automation counterfactual.

relations.title: Case Study: Texas-to-Mexico Oilfield Services Transformation: Knowledge Transfer, Industrialization, and Compliance
relations.reading: Knowledge-transfer evidence can include safe novel-exception exercises rather than relying only on document completion.

relations.title: Supply Chain Rationalization & Process Mining
relations.reading: Operational traces can anchor a conservative estimate of compensatory work while leaving their coverage gaps explicit.

relations.title: Nestlé North America — Where JUBAP Was Named
relations.reading: A future evaluation could separate the cost of building facilitator capability from any later reduction in compensatory coordination work.

relations.title: The Outlook
relations.reading: The programme's forecasts become testable only when their indicators, populations, time windows and disconfirming outcomes are specified.

relations.title: Annex 6 — Ablation, Sufficiency and Extensibility
relations.reading: Task simulations could vary integration, data quality and expert support separately to examine which assumptions drive a human-work counterfactual.

relations.title: Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: The task-level protocol operationalizes the earlier role-based framework; its time ratios should not be compared with operator ratios without an explicit conversion model.

relations.title: Architectural Entropy: How Mediated Systems Spend Human “Exergy” and the Partial Irreversibility of Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: The recovery coefficient turns the atrophy claim into a bounded question: how much released capacity becomes genuine contribution again for the same capability and cohort?

relations.title: The Limits of AI Oversight
relations.reading: The oversight-threshold study tests whether added review and reconciliation outweigh removed work, rather than treating guardrail count as a measure of debt.

relations.title: The Harvester Multiplication Problem: Capability Fragmentation, Governance Collapse and the Compounding of Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: Capability multiplicity is a screening signal; avoidable compensatory work must still be established from task episodes and a credible replacement counterfactual.

relations.title: What Goes Unpriced Is Paid in Human Intelligence
relations.reading: Unpriced clarity may consume human effort, but only the task-level distinction between necessary work and fixable compensation can classify that effort as debt.

relations.title: Distributed Tiger Teams VS Freelancer Swarms
relations.reading: A common decision core may reduce human-as-API work, provided the cost of maintaining and qualifying that core is included in the comparison.

relations.title: Tacit Knowledge Management in Distributed Tiger Teams
relations.reading: A practice-based transmission programme could provide the capability-recovery arm of an HID intervention, separately from the integration fix that releases time.

relations.title: The Anthropology of Tiger Team Activation
relations.reading: A Tiger Team evaluation should include activation, learning and closure costs, while distinguishing necessary mission work from avoidable compensation.

relations.title: Tiger Team Maturity Model
relations.reading: Validated task measurement can strengthen intervention evidence without by itself upgrading a defined Tiger Team model to quantitatively managed maturity.

relations.title: The Formación Integral © JubAp.Net (JubAp.Net) School of Invisible Talent
relations.reading: Genuine contribution should be classified at the task episode, not inferred from a person's title, credentials or membership in an elite team.

relations.title: Entropy, Capability Activation and Sociotechnical Engineering
relations.reading: Carrier availability at an activation threshold and the HID recovery coefficient answer different questions: who can respond now, and what capability returns after the architecture changes.

relations.title: Case Study: Weatherford Multi-Level Information Management for Oilfield Supplier Management
relations.reading: Reusable audit evidence provides a concrete setting for distinguishing avoidable reconstruction from necessary assurance, while measuring the net work of maintaining the shared evidence model.

relations.title: The Integral Management Society : Institución de frontera desde 1898
relations.reading: The preservation rationale motivates a testable question, while the HID measurement programme explicitly keeps recovery and irreversibility as hypotheses awaiting field evidence.

relations.title: Annex 01K — Human Capacity / Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: The 01K extension imports the HID research line while keeping runtime response capacity distinct from instrument-gated architectural debt measurement.
